objective: Minimize modeled draft head row work subject to at least 99.0% token-count-weighted coverage on the five fixed non-benchmark documents. This constrained objective deliberately does not use benchmark timing or acceptance to select N.
rule: Choose the smallest positive multiple of 256 covering >= 990/1000 tokens. Produce exactly one N; if N >= 91392, close without a smaller candidate. Never retune from device results.
tokenization: Exact packet56 tokenizer, no special tokens or chat template; original source bytes retrieved from source_commit. Recompute after this preregistration is committed.
independence: Historical packet56 preregistration and selection (including its retained histogram) were read as explicitly requested. No new selection calculation has run. No suite-inputs-20261012 prompts or oracle outputs have been read. Corpus is unchanged general operations/design/publication/storage material, not target-generated calibration.
cost_analysis_after_selection: Derive linear row-work cost with fixed per-row arithmetic and argmax; use the supplied historical ~0.52 ms prefix bucket as an explicitly dated planning proxy only after N is frozen. No current direct profile is claimed. Estimate additional rejection conservatively as the frequency mass in [N,91392), with no credit for possible new hits; this is a corpus proxy, not measured draft acceptance.
device_decision: One lane-B native A/B/A/B/A, A=91392, B=selected N, twelve prompts x128 plus incident64 per view. Every token exact vs iq3-p49-split32-v1, cached_tokens=0, control drift <=3%, both B rates >=1.005 times strongest A. Otherwise reject; never choose another N from bracket. Record per-arm draft acceptance and counts. Screening only, no promotion.
resource_policy: CPU only preparation; <=8GiB per CPU main, no import-time limits; <=150MB build; serialized compile_turn; no frozen tree or live queue edits.
